spec.title: NIGHT COAST
spec.oneLiner: Drift through a moonlit coastal circuit, release turbo boosts, and beat five rivals across three laps.
mechanics: Race one player kart against five computer rivals on a scrolling pseudo-3D coastal circuit with ordered checkpoints and three laps.
Use A or UP to accelerate, LEFT/RIGHT to steer, and DOWN to brake; hold B while turning to enter a drift, then release B to cash the stored drift into a short turbo boost.
Drifting charges only while the kart is turning with B held; release timing determines the turbo burst, rewarding controlled corner exits rather than simply holding boost.
The first straight teaches steering and includes an early boost strip; the first broad corner gives a safe drift opportunity, while later corners and off-road edges demand braking and line choice.
Road boost strips provide immediate speed bursts, while leaving the road causes strong slowdown; kart-to-kart collisions cause a brief wobble and positional loss without stopping the race.
AI rivals follow the same acceleration, lateral movement, collision, and off-road rules, with bounded pace and corner caution that increase modestly across the race.
Checkpoint gates must be crossed in order on every lap; missed or reverse crossings do not advance progress. Each valid gate awards a small score bonus once per lap and gives a bright gate flash.
The race uses pressure and recovery phases: an easy opening, alternating straights and corners, a tighter harbor/cliff peak near the final lap, then a final recovery straight toward the finish.
The first human finisher ends the race after a short finish window; in one-player mode the player wins only by finishing ahead of all rivals. Completing three laps shows position and time results.
Resetting after a loss or restart clears lap, checkpoint, drift charge, score bonuses, rival positions, and deterministic track state.
spec.artDirection: 256x224 pseudo-3D arcade view with large readable karts in the lower-center roadway: the player kart has a bright cyan body, white headlights, and a yellow helmet, while five rivals use distinct red, orange, green, purple, and blue body colors with contrasting helmets. Use a dark navy sky, moonlit ocean, pale surf, black cliffs, warm harbor lights, palms, and reflective road markings; keep the road and active karts high-contrast against the quiet background. Show clear steering, left/right drift, boost flame, and four-frame crash-spin poses using the bundled kart art, with cyan exhaust and gold turbo flashes as event feedback. Track scenery alternates between beach, cliffs, palms, and harbor around one continuous night circuit.

controls.left: Steer left while racing; also shapes a left drift when B is held.
controls.right: Steer right while racing; also shapes a right drift when B is held.
controls.down: Brake while racing; reduces speed before tight corners.
controls.a: Accelerate while racing, as an alternative to UP.
controls.b: Hold during a turn to charge and maintain a drift; release during the drift to trigger its turbo.

spec.lose: The player loses by running out of the 180-second race timer without finishing, or finishes behind every rival.
spec.scoring: Score comes from valid checkpoint crossings, finishing position, and successful drift-release turbos; each checkpoint is awarded once per lap and turbo feedback is shown immediately.
